question: What powers arise from this stage of meditative accomplishment?
premises: Knowledge of hearing from afar is mentioned.
These are presented as attained powers.
inference: This stage yields the power of distant hearing and the paralysis of bonds.
uncertainties: pāśa-stobha may mean arresting or immobilizing bonds or fetters.
plain_english: O beloved, one gains knowledge of distant hearing and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
